player_prompt.intro: Wo rebɔ PegJump. Fa nnua baako so kɔ foforo so wɔ abura a ɛnni hwee mu, yi nea woatutu no fi hɔ. Botae: wie bere a aka mmɛnnaa **koro** pɛ. Akwankyerɛ kwan: sɛ nhwɛso '[4 1]'.

invalid_move.wrong_format: Ntwerɔdeɛ a enni mu. Fa [i->j] di dwuma.

outcome.win: Wɔyɛɛ no bere a na aka nkɔnsɔnkɔnsɔn biako!
